findings.description: Accepted for decomposition, mandatory before the wave0 baseline seal. The distinction between a changed request and changed sources is required by C25 and proved by bp-0007, but has no typed spelling in the closed vocabulary: C10 collapses both causes into StaleCursor, C14's code list is closed with ViewScopeMismatch already assigned to C23, C21's RecoveryAction offers only StartFreshQuery for this path, and C21 forbids free-form detail strings. Nothing in the guide is false as written, so this does not block the decomposition; it is an unimplementable proof obligation that must be resolved in tk-0001's declarations before team/baseline.dd.json is sealed, because a later shared failure-enum change returns to tk-0001 and invalidates dependent proof. pij-empirical-tiger has recorded the concrete wave0 requirement: StaleCursor exposes closed CursorMismatchReason::{QueryOptionsChanged,SourceViewChanged}, the check tests query binding before view binding, guidance is cause-specific, SDK and CLI tests cover it, and malformed tokens continue to fail as InvalidArgument. Checked against the frozen contracts, that requirement satisfies this finding and needs no change to C14's code list or C21's RecoveryAction. It is recorded, not present in guide bytes; whether it lands correctly is for the baseline review to establish.
